title: Community sanitation route and tool roster
summary: Organizes waste, toilet supplies, handwashing stations, and cleanup tools during long disruption.
content: Community sanitation route and tool roster is a practical offline routine for sanitation operations. Map toilets, handwashing points, waste zones, water points, and living/sleeping areas. Create a route that removes waste without crossing clean food or drinking-water zones. Assign pairs for sanitation work and provide handwashing after every shift. Track soap, water, bags, tools, odors, flies, rodents, and overflow. Rotate duties fairly while protecting people with medical risks from high-exposure tasks.
